defs.def: to show the image of sb/sth on the surface of sth such as a mirror, water or glass 反映；映出（影像）

ex.s: History is a mirror reflecting reality．
ex.t: 历史是反映现实的镜子．

ex.s: As the small boat moved,   68   (gentle) along the river he was left speechless by the mountains being silently reflected in the water.
ex.t: 当小船移动时，   68  （轻柔）地沿河而下，群山在水中静静倒影的景象让他哑口无言。

ex.s: An eagle flew over the snow-capped mountains, which were reflected in the still lake below.
ex.t: 一只鹰飞过白雪皑皑的山峰，山峰倒映在下方宁静的湖水中。

ex.s: The mountains were reflected in the still lake below.
ex.t: 群山倒映在下方宁静的湖水中。

ex.s: In southern Spain the sudden increase of greenhouses (which reflect light back to space) has changed the warming trend locally, and actually cooled the region.
ex.t: 我们的祖先生活在热量匮乏的世界，我们的大脑发展出一种对这些甜食的反应机制，这种机制反映了它们的价值——一种奖赏和满足感。

ex.s: The movements of the black and white pieces reflect the basic ideas of Eastern philosophy, according to Tu Ningning, who is in charge of the exhibition.
ex.t: 据负责此次展览的涂宁宁介绍，黑白棋子的走法反映了东方哲学的基本理念。

ex.s: In contrast to the court life and upper-class culture represented by the Forbidden City, the Summer Palace, and the Temple of Heaven, the hutongs reflect _____65_____ culture of grassroots Beijingers.
ex.t: 与故宫、颐和园和天坛所代表的宫廷生活和上层文化形成对比的是，胡同反映了北京普通百姓的_____65_____草根文化。

ex.s: It reflects the patient's creativity.
ex.t: 它反映了患者的创造力。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关联的新型计时方式这些状况可能因全球变暖而发生变化．我们正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座钟它反映了几条主要阿拉斯加河流的总流量这些河流对当地和全球的环境变化都很敏感．我们已经编程让它在水流保持当前速率时与原子钟同步．如果将来河流平均流速加快钟会比标准时间走得快．如果河流变慢你会看到相反的效果．

ex.s: Consider and keep in mind why you want to make a change, including how the change reflects your values.
ex.t: 考虑并记住你为什么要做出改变，包括这种改变如何反映你的价值观。

ex.s: English was invented by people, not computers, and it reflects the creativity of the human race.
ex.t: 英语是由人而不是计算机发明的，它反映了人类的创造力。

defs.def: to throw back light, heat, sound, etc. from a surface 反射（声、光、热等）

ex.s: One very hot summer, the sun reflected off it and melted cars parked below!
ex.t: 在一个非常炎热的夏天，阳光从上面反射下来，把停在下面的汽车都晒化了！

ex.s: Because of the way light reflects off the organisms，these phytoplankton create colourful patterns at the ocean surface.
ex.t: 由于光线从生物体上反射的方式，这些浮游植物在海洋表面形成了彩色的图案。

ex.s: The way light reflects off marine organisms.
ex.t: 光线从海洋生物上反射的方式。

defs.def: to show or be a sign of the nature of sth or of sb's attitude or feeling 显示，表明，表达（事物的自然属性或人们的态度、情感等）

ex.s: I talked to one of the senior applicants who answered questions in a way that reflected the faith she had in herself.
ex.t: 我与一位资深的申请者交谈，她回答问题时体现出她对自己的信心。

ex.s: Peoples lifestyles are reflected in languages
ex.t: 人们的生活方式反映在语言中

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即使这种计时方法的具体细节是新颖的早期农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来．例如在前古典希腊时期人们通过向前或向后调整日期来"修正"官方历法以反映季节的变化．与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要．同样河流时间和其他我们正在开发的计时系统可能会促进环保意识．

ex.s: We are tempted by sugary treats because our ancestors lived in a calorie-poor world, and our brains developed a response mechanism to these treats that reflected their value — a feeling of reward and satisfaction.
ex.t: 我们会被含糖零食诱惑，因为我们的祖先生活在一个热量匮乏的世界里，我们的大脑对这些零食产生了一种反映其价值的反应机制——一种奖励和满足的感觉。

ex.s: Mr Dena kept an unforgettable ___41___ by Sir Isaac Newton on his chalk board: “If I have been able to see further, it is only because I stand on the shoulders of giants.” He reflected on that throughout the year and was ___42___ to teach us more than math.
ex.t: 德纳先生的黑板上有牛顿的一句难忘的话：“如果我看得更远，那是因为我站在巨人的肩膀上。”他一整年都在思考这句话，并____42____教会我们的不仅仅是数学。

ex.s: Reading history is an amazing experience because it enables us to reflect on the social and economic life of the people living long time ago.
ex.t: 阅读历史是一种奇妙的经历，因为它使我们能够反思很久以前人们的社会和经济生活。

defs.def: to think carefully and deeply about sth 认真思考；沉思

ex.s: When we slow down, we create space to reflect on our thoughts and emotions, which helps us identify important areas of our lives and ___13___ (give) us the opportunity to make right choices.
ex.t: 当我们放慢脚步时，我们就创造出了反思自己想法和情绪的空间，这有助于我们认清生活中重要的方面，并____（给予）我们做出正确选择的机会。

ex.s: As it turns out, however, this same concept-one that most consumers make many times each day with reflecting on it-is the basis of the more formal budget line concept in economics , which is explained below.
ex.t: 然而事实证明，这个概念——大多数消费者每天都会多次做出、却不会加以思考的概念——是经济学中更正式的预算线概念的基础，下文将对此进行解释。

ex.s: And if you're in any doubt about this, take a moment to reflect on this line from The Secret Garden: "Where you tend a rose...
ex.t: 如果你对此有任何疑问，请花点时间回想一下《秘密花园》中的这句话：＂你在哪里照料一朵玫瑰……

ex.s: “I reflect on how my day's gone and think about the rest of the week,” he said.
ex.t: "我反思这一天过得怎么样，想想这一周剩下的时间，"他说。
